standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to the observation that only finitely many summands can occur.

core_obligations: Cover by trivialising opens: for a section of the direct sum the proof chooses an open covering on which it becomes a finite sum of sections of the individual summands (proof lines 524-527)

Use quasi-compactness: since the open is quasi-compact the covering may be taken finite, so only finitely many summands and finitely many indices occur, and the section is a section of the direct sum over a finite subset of the index set (proof lines 528-532)
Conclude: for a finite index set the sections of the direct sum are the direct sum of the sections, which gives the bijectivity (proof lines 532-534)
proof_roadmap: 设 s 是直和的截面，取开覆盖 U = ⋃U_j 使 s|_{U_j} 是有限和 ∑_{i∈I_j} s_{ji}。
由 U 准紧可取该覆盖有限，于是 I' = ⋃_j I_j 有限，s 落于有限直和 ⊕_{i∈I'} F_i 之中；有限直和时层化不必要（本章引理），故该映射是双射。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a quasi-compact open subset the sections of an arbitrary direct sum of sheaves of modules are the direct sum of the sections of the summands (author lemma at source lines 509-521, label lemma-section-direct-sum-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 523-535) takes a section of the direct sum, writes it locally as a finite sum of sections of individual summands, uses quasi-compactness to pass to a finite covering so that only finitely many summands occur, and then invokes the description of the sections of a finite direct sum (proof lines 524-534). The reduction to a finite index set by quasi-compactness is the content. H2.
